content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02079 If the configured ComSignalDataInvalidValue is received for a signal and the ComDataInvalidAction is configured to NOTIFY for this signal, the AUTOSAR COM module shall notify the users (e.g. RTE, SwCluC) via the configured <Co- mUser_CbkInv> function. In this case, no other signal processing like filtering or the normal signal indication shall take place.
